description: A dynamic tuple element unified with an object element stays the dynamic value
notes: The spec says the dynamic pseudo-type unifies with any other type to that type, so the element should become an unknown object. go-cty gives up on element types that are all objects or dynamic and chooses the dynamic pseudo-type (unifyAllAsDynamic, called from unifyObjectTypes in cty/convert/unify.go), while a dynamic element and a number element unify to number (conditional-dynamic-element-unifies-with-number). An implementation whose unknown values are all dynamic would pass regardless, hence typed-values.
